user.title: VoIP Stack
user.description: SIP softphone and SIP bridge/router for ESPHome VoIP phones. HA listens on SIP UDP and TCP automatically.

data.media_capture: Record private call audio for diagnostics
data.experimental_sip_video: Enable SIP video for the Home Assistant softphone

data_description.sip_port: Listen port for the HA SIP endpoint. HA accepts SIP signaling over both UDP and TCP on this port.
data_description.rtp_port: Base RTP UDP port for HA media and relays.
data_description.advertise_host: Optional override published in ESP phonebooks. Use this when HA is behind routing, NAT, LXC, VPN, or multiple subnets and the automatically announced address is not reachable by ESP devices.
data_description.assist_intents: Register optional Assist handlers for call, hang up, answer and decline ("Hey Jarvis, call Kitchen"). Spoken contact names are resolved dynamically against the live VoIP phonebook.
data_description.assist_endpoint_enabled: Add a SIP extension backed directly by a Home Assistant Assist pipeline. No separate VoIP integration or SIP listener is required.
data_description.debug_mode: Enables detailed SIP/RTP/media diagnostics and logs without recording call audio.
data_description.media_capture: Explicitly records private call audio: up to 15 seconds per HA-softphone direction and 8 seconds per relay leg, stored as WAV/JSON in ~/.cache/voip_stack_debug (mode 0700) and pruned to 24 files / 64 MiB. Keep disabled unless collecting a diagnostic capture.
data_description.experimental_sip_video: Let the Home Assistant softphone negotiate SIP video with compatible standard phones, softphones and door stations. H.264, VP8 and JPEG use the browser media path. Standard ESP endpoints remain audio-only; qualified ESP32-P4 profiles can negotiate JPEG or H.264. Requires HTTPS and a compatible browser.
data_description.sip_registrar_enabled: Accept REGISTER from local SIP endpoints such as VoIP phones, Zoiper, Linphone or baresip using accounts managed by VoIP Stack services.
data_description.trunk_enabled: Show provider/PBX trunk settings. When disabled, no trunk registration, external route or DTMF collector starts.

video.title: SIP video
video.description: Video is optional. The Home Assistant softphone and standard SIP endpoints support it, and qualified ESP32-P4 profiles can negotiate JPEG or H.264. Other ESP endpoints remain audio-only.

data_description.video_transcoding_enabled: Allow VoIP Stack to use Home Assistant's FFmpeg binary when two negotiated video legs have no direct codec match. Direct H.264, VP8 and JPEG remain preferred. The bounded fallback can convert legacy video for the HA softphone and H.264 or JPEG between HA-owned SIP legs. Browser JPEG send may also use one bounded RFC 2435 normalizer. Failure leaves compatible audio active.
data_description.video_camera_send_enabled: Expose a Send Camera choice in the card. Each logical Home Assistant phone keeps its choice; camera permission remains local to each browser. Receiving video never requires camera access.

assist.title: Voice assistant extension
assist.description: Choose the SIP extension and Home Assistant Assist pipeline used for telephone calls. When advanced call details are enabled, VoIP Stack starts the conversation with a user message such as `Incoming SIP call from "Daniele".` Configure telephone behavior in the selected conversation agent's own Instructions or prompt field under Settings > Devices & services > the agent integration > Configure. Example instructions: `When you receive a message beginning with "Incoming SIP call from", treat it as a live phone call. Greet the caller once, act as a concise receptionist, and do not repeat their name in every reply.` Friendly mood: `During SIP calls, sound cheerful and informal while remaining concise and helpful.` Terrible mood: `Hi. I don't give a s**t, so please go f**k yourself.`

data.assist_advanced_call_context: Provide advanced call details to the assistant

data_description.assist_extension: Numeric extension from 1 to 255 digits, unique across accounts, contacts and groups.
data_description.assist_pipeline: Assist pipeline used for speech recognition, conversation and text-to-speech on telephone calls.
data_description.assist_advanced_call_context: When disabled, Assist starts listening without an initial text message. When enabled, sends the caller name and ID, phonebook match, source and called extension once at connection. These are untrusted call metadata; a phonebook match is not authentication.

trunk.title: Optional SIP Trunk
trunk.description: Connect Home Assistant to one provider or PBX. Incoming calls follow the configured routing and optional automations.

data.automation_routing_enabled: Allow automations to select the inbound destination

data_description.trunk_transport: SIP transport used from HA to the provider.
data_description.trunk_domain: Optional SIP realm/domain. Defaults to the trunk server when empty.
data_description.trunk_username: SIP account user and default incoming Request-URI user.
data_description.trunk_auth_username: Digest auth username when different from the SIP username.
data_description.trunk_outbound_proxy: Optional proxy host or sip:host:port used as signaling next hop.
data_description.trunk_inbound_default_target: Select the receiving phone by name, or enter a group, extension or Automation contact. Immediate routing uses this destination when the called destination is not in the phonebook. DTMF selection and routing automations can choose another destination.
data_description.trunk_inbound_mode: Route immediately skips digit collection. Collect extension with DTMF answers the trunk leg first and lets explicit digits select a phonebook extension.
data_description.automation_routing_enabled: Before using the fallback destination, publish a short routing request that an automation may answer. Explicit DTMF digits always keep priority.
data_description.trunk_dtmf_timeout_ms: Inter-digit timeout used in DTMF mode. The first digit is allowed 10 seconds. Default is 3 seconds, maximum is 10 seconds.
data_description.trunk_dtmf_terminator: Optional terminator digit such as #. Empty means timeout or exact phonebook extension match decides.
data_description.trunk_allowed_ips: Enter each permitted source IP or CIDR network separately. These may differ from the outbound server. Required without registration.
data_description.trunk_audio_codecs: Audio codecs permitted for incoming and outgoing calls on this trunk. Keep the defaults unless your PBX/provider specifies a list. Select at least one codec. A call needs a common codec; DTMF is negotiated separately. This list does not change other trunks or local phones.
data_description.trunk_video_codecs: Video codecs permitted on this trunk. Clear the list for audio-only calls. Selecting a codec does not enable video or transcoding: the phone and media path must support it. H.264 profiles are negotiated automatically. Keep the defaults if unsure.
data_description.trunk_outbound_media_address: Used only in manual mode. HA IPv4 address reachable by the PBX, with RTP/RTCP ports reachable without port translation.
data_description.trunk_media_nat: Automatic discovers RTP/RTCP addresses and ports using Home Assistant STUN servers. Direct uses routed networking. Manual uses the IPv4 override.

trunk_mode.title: Trunk registration
trunk_mode.description: Keep this enabled for a provider account. Disable it for a static trunk that accepts calls without REGISTER. Configure allowed incoming IPs in the next step.

voicemail.title: Voicemail voice
voicemail.description: Choose the Home Assistant TTS entity used by the shared telephone menu.

voicemail_voice.title: Voicemail voice
voicemail_voice.description: Choose the voice used for telephone menu prompts.

reconfigure.title: VoIP Stack settings
reconfigure.description: Choose which settings to configure. All PBX applications are available; configure their resources when needed.

phone_services.title: LDAP directory
phone_services.description: The standard directory accepts enabled phone accounts even while offline. Simple bind without TLS sends credentials over the network. For StartTLS on the normal listener, provide a certificate and key; TLS selects implicit LDAPS instead. Temporary listener failure preserves the directory on phones.

phone_provisioning.title: Physical phone provisioning
phone_provisioning.description: Enable the optional profile catalog and physical phone setup. Existing SIP accounts remain the owners of credentials and calls. The public URL must be reachable by your phones.
